description.value: The Lynn Valley Library is the main hub of the North Vancouver District Public Library system, situated at the corner of Lynn Valley Road and Mountain Highway. Built in 2007 as a LEED-certified structure, it features a StoryLab digital creativity studio, study spaces, and programs for all ages. Notably, NVDPL lends e-cargo bikes from its collection — a rare and practical resource for cyclists passing through the area.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms this is a real, active public library — the main hub of the NVDPL system, LEED certified, built in 2007. OSM tags internet_access=wlan and internet_access:fee=no are corroborated by the website's 'Computers & Wifi' section. No explicit evidence on the website for bike parking, washrooms, or water refill, so those remain null; the website does notably list 'E-Cargo Bikes' as a borrowable item under the Borrowing menu.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A real, operational public library that is the main branch of the NVDPL system, with free Wi-Fi and the unique offering of borrowable e-cargo bikes — clearly useful to touring cyclists.
enrichment_extras.notes: NVDPL lends e-cargo bikes (listed under Borrowing > E-Cargo Bikes on the website). This may warrant follow-up to confirm whether the e-cargo bike lending program is based at this branch specifically or system-wide.

wow_evidence: Library ladder 1/1; LEED main branch, e-cargo bike lending.
blurb: Lynn Valley's LEED-built main library; lends e-cargo bikes.
